sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A 3-part traversal, not a fight — Spectral Rifts, then Spirit Race, then Cemetery. Condition cleanses and knockdown prevention matter more than damage here.

sections.heading: Spectral Rifts
bullets: Capture the red circles before the falling orbs reach the ground — letting a rift explode is generally a squad wipe, so this is the one part of the encounter with zero room for error.
Use portals and mobility skills to reach multiple circles quickly — a Mesmer's portal is especially good for getting the squad to a rift fast.

sections.heading: Spirit Race
bullets: After the rifts clear, the squad glides into a timed section — clear the path ahead fast enough to stay in front of a wall of spirits slowly creeping in from behind.
Similar circle-capture mechanics apply here as in the Rifts phase.

sections.heading: Cemetery
bullets: The final phase needs all 5 squad members standing on hidden buttons scattered around the area at the same time to open the exit gate.
